Intro: So then… the site of the whirlpool must be right about… here!
Curious thing ye are… Ahoy, good sea monster. I hear ye call these waters yer own.
Mind not I, charting the tides 'round your abode. Though… if ye got [DISH] to spare, I'd be in yer debt if ye gave me some.
Success: Brings a tear to the eye. Wait till' my mates hear the tale of the hospitable sea monster! Ha ha!
Fail: Aye… a less capable sailor might've gotten caught in yer waters. Careful of wreckage.
Reject: Foul fishbeast! I was always ready to go down with my ship! Ye don't scare me!
